citations.description: Fixture only asserts .rebar absence, not list_tickets() == []
list_tickets() == [] assertion is in a separate test, not the fixture

findings.criterion: The template fixture asserts it is virgin (no tickets, no `<repo>/.rebar/`).
findings.detail: The `_rebar_repo_template` fixture in conftest.py asserts `not (repo / ".rebar").exists()` (line 92), covering the 'no `.rebar/`' half. It does NOT call `rebar.list_tickets()` to assert 'no tickets'. The 'no tickets' assertion exists only in the separate `test_template_stays_virgin` test (test_rebar_repo_isolation.py:216), not in the fixture itself. The AC specifically says 'the template fixture asserts it is virgin (no tickets, no `<repo>/.rebar/`)'.
